v1.0.0.title: TXATOOL - WIN - Changelog v1.0.0
content: Official launch of TXATOOL - WIN: The all-in-one toolkit designed for IT technicians and power users.
Integrated WSAP: Automated Windows installation directly from ISO onto target drive without requiring a USB boot drive.
Advanced network printer troubleshooting (fixes stubborn errors 0x0000011b, 0x00000709, 0x0000007c, RPC, and firewall issues).
Windows Edition Converter (Convert SKUs): Seamless switching between Home, Pro, Enterprise, and IoT Enterprise LTSC.
Smart License Manager: Check activation status, backup and restore digital licenses, and remove unwanted activation traces.
Deep system optimization: Disable telemetry, reduce latency, tune services, and comprehensive disk & cache cleaning.
UWP Debloat & Startup Apps Manager: Safely remove Windows bloatware and speed up system startup time.
Curated Software Store with hundreds of essential, verified applications ready for instant download.
Custom Microsoft Office Deployment tool for tailored installation of required Office apps and versions.
Modern Fluent Glass UI with full Light/Dark Theme auto-switching and bilingual support (Vietnamese & English).
